definitions.explanation: the unwanted flow of electric current through an unintended path, often caused by damaged insulation

examples.japanese: {漏電|ろうでん}が{火災|かさい}の{原因|げんいん}だった。
examples.english: An electrical leak was the cause of the fire.

examples.japanese: {漏電|ろうでん}{遮断|しゃだん}{器|き}が{作動|さどう}した。
examples.english: The earth leakage circuit breaker activated.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{配線|はいせん}は{漏電|ろうでん}の{危険|きけん}があるので、{点検|てんけん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Old wiring has a risk of electrical leakage, so inspection is necessary.

notes:
{漏電|ろうでん} refers to electrical current leaking through unintended paths, a serious safety hazard.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {漏|ろう} (leak)
- {電|でん} (electricity)

SAFETY CONCERN:
- Can cause electrical fires
- Can lead to electric shock
- Often caused by aged or damaged insulation

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {漏電|ろうでん}{遮断|しゃだん}{器|き} (earth leakage circuit breaker / ELCB)
- {漏電|ろうでん}{火災|かさい} (fire caused by electrical leak)
- {漏電|ろうでん}{検査|けんさ} (electrical leak inspection)

USAGE:
- {漏電|ろうでん}する (to have an electrical leak - suru verb)
- {漏電|ろうでん}している (there is an electrical leak)

RELATED TERMS:
- {感電|かんでん} (electric shock)
- {配線|はいせん} (wiring)
- ブレーカー (circuit breaker)
